primaryParentContext.publisher: APAL study by Geoidd / Ceta / Betbel, hosted as source material by Ramsar
primaryParentContext.documentDate: November 2002 on cover; PDF creation metadata July2005 is not the study date.
primaryParentContext.finding: Page77 describes Soliman Plage as a partly built municipal subdivision organized into planning blocks U21–U24. The table totals52.10ha,540 built and140 vacant lots. It supports historical inhabited parent-area identity.
primaryParentContext.qualification: The report does not link the OSM S1–S31/32–88 identifiers, certify their boundaries or establish current legal/address status. Its planning codes differ from these OSM labels. Preserve the named parent; do not claim88 official planned lots.

qualifiedObservations.finding: Named search returned Soliman Beach, alternate name Soliman Plage, as a tourist attraction POI near the beach. This supports public beach-name context only, not the residential locality identity or its full polygon.

Coordinate query returned a generic Soliman card in Tunisia. The map shows the coastal residential street grid near the beach mosque and public Soliman Plage business labels. No numbered block name or exact residential boundary was displayed.
S1 representative coordinate returned a generic Soliman card, with the pin near the northeastern end of the coastal street grid. Neither S1 nor a distinct named neighborhood was confirmed.
Block32 representative coordinate returned a generic Soliman card on the coastal street grid, near public Soliman Plage labels. No32 locality identity or boundary was confirmed.
Block88 representative coordinate returned a generic Soliman card near the southwestern street grid of the same coastal residential area. No88 locality identity or exact boundary was confirmed.

supplementaryPublicMapsReview.qualification: Root personally viewed the five public observations. These show broad beach/street-grid context, not exact numeric-code identity or polygon certification. No result absence is interpreted as nonexistence. No Google geometry or phone images are copied.

preservation.otherRawRepresentativeInsideBlock42: The existing named parent representative is inside block42; the parent raw record remains unchanged.
preservation.savedSelection: Existing retired-ID handling clears saved locality identity and leaves stored prayer delegation and GPS preference unchanged. No automatic parent-ID replacement is invented.
preservation.prayerSources: All other raw defaults and all prayer references remain identical. Existing actual-GPS nearest selection is preserved.

limitations: Source-object classification only, not88 certified planning lots or proof that numbered neighborhoods cannot exist.
The APAL2002 planning codes U21–U24 are different and do not identify these88 OSM shapes.
Current source sector and separately held native ISIE boundaries differ materially; both the live boundary and named parent remain unchanged.
No ownership, occupancy, cadastral or exact building-roof claim; no private occupant research.
